templates.title: Stoat
templates.name: stoat
templates.description: Stoat is a self-hosted chat server, formerly Revolt. This stack runs the API, web app, file server, proxy, and voice ingress behind Caddy.

env.name: HOSTNAME
env.label: HOSTNAME
env.description: Caddy site address. Default is https://stoat.localhost. Change this literal, the VITE variables, and every REVOLT__HOSTS__* value to the public origin before the first start. Caddy reads this value when the container starts.

env.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
env.label: MINIO_ROOT_USER
env.description: Silo root user. Must match the S3 access key.

env.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.label: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
env.description: Silo root password. Must match REVOLT__FILES__S3__SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. The catalog value is public. Replace both copies, including the createbuckets service, before the first start. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit these literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.

env.name: MINIO_DOMAIN
env.label: MINIO_DOMAIN
env.description: Silo domain used for bucket aliases.

env.name: REVOLT__DATABASE__MONGODB
env.label: REVOLT__DATABASE__MONGODB
env.description: MongoDB URL for the database service.

env.name: REVOLT__DATABASE__REDIS
env.label: REVOLT__DATABASE__REDIS
env.description: Valkey URL for the redis service.

env.name: REVOLT__RABBIT__PASSWORD
env.label: REVOLT__RABBIT__PASSWORD
env.description: RabbitMQ password. Must match RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS. The catalog value is public. Replace both before the first start. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit these literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.

env.name: REVOLT__FILES__ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.label: REVOLT__FILES__ENCRYPTION_KEY
env.description: File encryption key. Losing it loses access to stored files. The catalog value is public. Replace it before creating data, then keep the replacement. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit this literal; they do not substitute Compose variables.

env.name: REVOLT__FILES__S3__ENDPOINT
env.label: REVOLT__FILES__S3__ENDPOINT
env.description: S3 endpoint for the silo service.

env.name: REVOLT__PUSHD__VAPID__PRIVATE_KEY
env.label: REVOLT__PUSHD__VAPID__PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Web push VAPID private key. The catalog value is public. Replace it before the first start. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit this literal; they do not substitute Compose variables.

env.name: REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY
env.label: REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY
env.description: LiveKit API key. The catalog value is public. Replace it before exposing voice. livekit-config writes this value into livekit.yml on start, so set the same plaintext on that service. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit these literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.

env.name: REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__SECRET
env.label: REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__SECRET
env.description: LiveKit API secret. The catalog value is public. Replace it before exposing voice. livekit-config writes this value into livekit.yml on start, so set the same plaintext on that service. CasaOS and ZimaOS edit these literals; they do not substitute Compose variables.
